name: Benchmark Circuits for Single Flux Quantum (SFQ) Integrated Systems
description: Provides a set of benchmark SFQ circuit designs and performance metrics for evaluating single flux quantum integrated systems.
evaluation_method: hardware performance metrics (throughput, latency, energy per operation, error rate)
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark respected within the superconducting electronics and SFQ research community but not widely used in mainstream ML/quantum benchmarking.
notes: Non-LLM, hardware- and simulation-specific benchmark; small and specialized dataset of circuit designs. Results are sensitive to simulation/hardware setup and not directly comparable to software-only benchmarks.
